data.name: Nigam
data.gender_notes: Nigam is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Sanskrit, Nigam means 'one who creates poetry or music'. It is derived from the root word 'Nigh' which means 'to create'. Nigam is a revered title given to great poets and musicians in Hindu culture. The name Nigam carries the meaning “Poet, Musician, Melody Maker” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Nigam usually hope their child will grow to embody poet, musician, melody maker and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Creator of beauty and harmony in the universe
data.etymology: Nigam belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Poet, Musician, Melody Maker.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nigam total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
